answer_4.quote: We collect qualitative human judgments on the examples output by each negative sampler... We gather judgments for (R1) grammar on a binary scale (incorrect/correct) and (R2) thematic consistency of the head/tail phrases on a 4‑point scale ... We also obtain truthfulness judgments on a 4‑point scale ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated each generated statement on grammar (correct/incorrect), truthfulness (always/mostly/sometimes/never true), and consistency (highly/somewhat/a little/not consistent).
